Summary: EU-headquartered legaltech platform; global enterprise customers with multilingual contracts (EN/FR/DE/ES/PT/IT/AR). Wants a secure, low-latency RAG search experience with per-language recall/precision tuning and predictable cost per query.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Index scale: initial pilot 10M documents (mixed PDFs, scanned OCR), target production 50M+ docs over 12 months.
- Queries: bursty search traffic (350 qps peak), baseline 50 qps sustained. Need p95 latency target <= 250ms for text search, acceptable reranker p95 <= 600ms for cross-encoder only on top-k.
- Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query <= $0.005; willing to trade latency for cost on archive tiers.
- Multilingual coverage: high-quality embeddings for EN/FR/DE/ES/PT/IT; CLIR for AR/CN content. Require per-language recall >= 92% on benchmark sets, precision tuning for legal clause retrieval.
- Models: prefer open multilingual encoders (LaBSE / XLM-R variants) + distilled cross-encoder reranker for reranking. Interested in Redwood's model catalog and quantization advice.
- Routing/fallback: need policy to route high-priority customers to dedicated low-latency pool and fallback to cheaper variant on overload.
- Security: strict data residency (EU), SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS integration, audit logs retained 7 years for compliance.
